scenes.headline: How a robot arm learns with no critic
scenes.sub: Adapt-1 Machina: propose a command matrix, run it, grade it, edit it.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Rowan! Adapt-1 Machina trains a simulated arm with no critic. What does the critic's job?

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: The simulator is the critic. Propose a whole sequence of commands, run it, grade the outcome, and revise earlier attempts.
scenes.say: The simulator is the critic: propose a whole command sequence, run it, grade it, and revise earlier attempts.

scenes.title: A whole attempt is one matrix
scenes.text: a_k = (x, y, z, α, β, γ, g),  H ≤ 20
scenes.say: An attempt is one matrix. Each row is a command.

parts.note: at most 20 rows: 140 numbers, committed once
parts.say: Up to twenty rows, a hundred and forty numbers, committed before the arm moves.

items.say: Propose the whole matrix at once: one decision per attempt, not per step.
Run it in the simulator. Nothing estimates its value first.
Hand-written detectors grade it: contact, lift, transfer, and a placement that stays put.
Then revise a recorded attempt: keep its opening, change a few indexed numbers.

steps.say: One part is learned. It reads the starting observation through quadratic features.
It outputs a bounded correction, from weights that start at zero.
It's added to the sequence the search found, and clipped to the allowed range.

scenes.title: One layout, before and after
scenes.credit: Rei Labs' own two recordings, placed side by side

steps.say: That correction at work, in Rei Labs' own recordings: before it on the left, after on the right.
A few centimetres more on the release, and the cube lands in the bowl, not on its rim.

scenes.title: Target hits, by what the correction reads
scenes.note: aiming task: 768 cases over three trained policies
scenes.say: Feed it another case's observation and it does worse than none: sixty-two against eighty-five. It really reads the observation.

scenes.label: placement gain on 384 unseen arm layouts; 95% interval +0.78 to +11.72
scenes.say: On three hundred and eighty-four unseen layouts, placements rose six point two five points: seventy gained, forty-six lost. Its interval starts under one point.

scenes.text: No critic doesn't mean no cost: the simulator does the critic's job, one executed attempt at a time.
scenes.mark: the simulator does the critic's job

recap: An attempt is one open-loop command matrix
The simulator and stage detectors grade it
One small learned correction, from the observation
scenes.say: Propose a matrix, let the simulator grade it, edit, and learn one small correction.
